title: LICHEN L2 disable: retry incomplete queue destruction
description: Round-4 correctness review found that after common disable returns a deinit failure and leaves LORA_DESTROY_FAILED, retrying common disable calls stop(), receives success for the non-RUNNING state, skips deinit, and falsely reports successful teardown. Recognize DESTROY_FAILED on the common disable path, retry lichen_lora_l2_deinit(), and continue to propagate incomplete cleanup; add a regression.
